name: Build Test Docker Image

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      branch:
        description: 'Branch to build from'
        required: true
        default: 'main'
      commit_sha:
        description: 'Commit SHA to build from (optional, defaults to HEAD of branch)'
        required: false

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata for Docker
        id: meta
        run: |
          # Determine the commit SHA to use
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.commit_sha }}" ]; then
            SHA="${{ github.event.inputs.commit_sha }}"
          else
            SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          fi
          
          # Short SHA for tagging
          SHORT_SHA=$(echo $SHA | cut -c1-7)
          
          # Sanitize branch name for Docker tag (replace / with -)
          BRANCH_NAME=$(echo "${{ github.event.inputs.branch }}" | sed 's/\//-/g')
          
          # Construct the tag: {branch}-{sha}
          TAG="${BRANCH_NAME}-${SHORT_SHA}"
          
          # Image name: ghcr.io/{owner}/{repo}
          IMAGE_NAME="ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/opendata"
          
          echo "tag=${TAG}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "image=${IMAGE_NAME}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "sha=${SHA}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.source=${{ github.event.repository.html_url }}
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ steps.meta.outputs.sha }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Print image details
        run: |
          echo "Successfully built and pushed image:"
          echo "${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}"
